values.task: Make `slugify` in src/slugify.mjs spell out three symbols as words instead of dropping them: `&` becomes `and`, `@` becomes `at`, and `%` becomes `percent`, so "Fish & Chips" is "fish-and-chips" and "100% Cotton" is "100-percent-cotton". Add tests for them to tests/slugify.test.mjs.
values.claim: For every string `text` and every positive integer `maxLength`, `slugify(text, { maxLength })` contains only the characters a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens, never starts or ends with a hyphen, is at most `maxLength` characters long, and `slugify(slugify(text, { maxLength }), { maxLength })` equals `slugify(text, { maxLength })`.
